C1034.title: Software Employees Implant Backdoor in Wallet App to Steal User Credentials and Millions in Cryptocurrency
C1034.summary: Three employees at a Shanghai software company—Liu, Dong, and Zhang A—conspired to implant a backdoor in a cryptocurrency wallet application. The backdoor activated five days after installation, uploading private keys and mnemonic phrases to a designated server.
